implementation.contamination_control: The experiment excludes every current evidence fact in the selected objective task family, preserving only the intervention history channel for that family.
implementation.new_task_contract: Versioned v3 affine probe-suite task family; family is explicitly operator-declared and protocol-bound.
implementation.retrieval: Bounded 64-record scan prefers admitted records with exact selected source facts in the declared family, then fills remaining slots by recency.
implementation.source_outcome: Receipt-bound history-present observed answers are paired with probe identities and independently scored per-probe correctness; affine oracle parameters are omitted.
implementation.staging: Optional task-family-history requirement checks exact checkpointed records and independent admission before publishing a one-shot request.
implementation.writeback: Existing developmental-history source projection retains compact task-family and acquisition-example lineage under source-payload digest binding.

objective: Task-family source examples flow through canonical World-State and normal admitted writeback into later relevant cognition.
